content.value_statement: Presentations and documents often lose consistency when colors and fonts are chosen slide by slide. This skill applies curated or custom themes with defined palettes, typography, and usage guidance.
actual_capabilities: Shows a PDF theme showcase so users can compare available visual styles.
Offers ten named preset themes with palettes, fonts, and suggested contexts.
Reads Markdown theme specifications that include hex colors and typography choices.
Applies selected colors and fonts to slides, documents, reports, or HTML artifacts.
Creates a custom theme from user-provided style goals when presets do not fit.
Requests an explicit theme selection before changing the target artifact.
limitations: It provides design guidance and does not include executable styling automation.
The final result depends on the structure and editability of the target artifact.
Only ten preset themes are included before custom theme generation is needed.
The PDF showcase requires a viewer that can open local PDF files.

use_cases.title: Standardize Client Decks
use_cases.description: Apply a consistent palette and font pair to consulting or sales presentations before delivery.

use_cases.title: Refresh Internal Reports
use_cases.description: Give recurring reports a clear visual identity without rebuilding layouts from scratch.

use_cases.title: Prototype Brand Directions
use_cases.description: Generate or compare theme options for early website, document, or campaign concepts.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Preset Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the available Theme Factory themes and help me choose one for my presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Selected Theme
prompt_templates.scenario: User already knows the desired preset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Ocean Depths theme to this deck and keep the content structure unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Match Theme to Audience
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with context and goals.
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a theme for an executive strategy report about sustainable growth, then apply it after I confirm.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Custom Theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request when presets do not fit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for a premium cybersecurity briefing, show the palette and fonts, then wait for approval before applying it.

output_examples.input: Apply a calm professional style to a financial update deck.
output_examples.output: Recommended Ocean Depths because it uses navy, teal, seafoam, and cream for a calm professional tone. The deck would use DejaVu Sans Bold for headers and DejaVu Sans for body text.

output_examples.input: Create a theme for a modern AI product launch.
output_examples.output: A custom theme could use high-contrast dark backgrounds, bright blue accents, clean sans-serif headers, and restrained highlight colors for technical clarity.

output_examples.input: Make this report feel warmer without reducing readability.
output_examples.output: Golden Hour is a good fit because its warm palette supports an inviting tone while preserving dark text contrast for report sections.

best_practices: Review the PDF showcase before selecting a preset theme.
Confirm the chosen theme before applying visual changes to an artifact.
Check contrast and readability after applying colors and fonts.
anti_patterns: Do not apply a theme without user confirmation when several options are suitable.
Do not override important brand requirements with preset colors or fonts.
Do not sacrifice text contrast or layout clarity for decorative styling.

faq.question: What artifacts can this skill style?
faq.answer: It can guide styling for presentations, documents, reports, and HTML landing pages.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: It includes ten preset themes with named palettes, fonts, and suggested use cases.

faq.question: Can it create a new theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate a custom theme from your audience, tone, and subject requirements.

faq.question: Does it automatically edit files?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides theme selection and application instructions for the assistant to follow.

faq.question: Does it include font information?
faq.answer: Yes. Each theme includes header and body font choices.

faq.question: Should I inspect the output after applying a theme?
faq.answer: Yes. Always review readability, contrast, and consistency in the final artifact.
